2609.05043.title: EuroAlpaca: Task-Preserving Localisation of Instruction Data for European Languages
2609.05043.paper_summary: Machine translation (MT) offers a scalable way to extend English instruction-tuning data to multiple languages, but it can distort task-critical constraints and required outputs, creating corrupted training examples and degrading models trained on such data. We introduce EuroAlpaca, a task-preserving localisation pipeline and near-parallel resource covering 50 European languages and regional varieties, together with European-IFEval, a multilingual benchmark for verifiable instruction following. Depending on the example, our pipeline applies field-wise MT while preserving task-critical content or reconstructs a task-equivalent target-language instance, followed by validation of cross-field coherence and target-language consistency. Across LoRA experiments with four LLMs, training on directly translated data improves ROUGE-L and F-BERT on the Aya Evaluation Suite, but reduces accuracy on European-IFEval by 29.8% relative to the unadapted baseline. In contrast, adaptation with EuroAlpaca improves accuracy by 12.9% over the same baseline, reversing the degradation caused by direct MT, while also achieving the highest ROUGE-L and F-BERT scores on Aya. These results show that preserving task semantics is essential for multilingual instruction tuning.
2609.05043.paper_summary_zh: 機器翻譯 (MT) 提供了一種可擴展的方式，將英語教學調整數據擴展到多種語言，但它可能會扭曲任務關鍵約束和所需輸出，從而創造出損壞的訓練範例並降低基於這些數據訓練的模型的性能。<lb/>我們介紹了 EuroAlpaca，一個保持任務的本地化管道和涵蓋 50 種歐洲語言及區域變體的近平行資源，還有歐洲-IFEval，一個可驗證的多語言指令跟隨基準。<lb/>根據範例，我們的管道在保持任務關鍵內容的同時應用領域專用的 MT，或者重建一個任務等效的目標語言實例，隨後驗證跨領域的一致性和目標語言的一致性。<lb/>在對四個 LLM 進行的 LoRA 實驗中，基於直接翻譯數據的訓練在 Aya 評估套件上提高了 ROUGE-L 和 F-BERT，但相對於未調整的基線，在歐洲-IFEval 上降低了 29.8% 的準確性。<lb/>相比之下，使用 EuroAlpaca 的適應性提高了 12.9% 的準確性，超過了相同的基線，逆轉了直接 MT 所造成的降級，同時在 Aya 上也達到了最高的 ROUGE-L 和 F-BERT 分數。<lb/>這些結果表明，保持任務語義對於多語言指令調整至關重要。
